crossRefs.note: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, Yahweh’s house and the king’s house

parallels.note: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, Yahweh’s house and the king’s house

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built Yahweh’s house and his own house,
translations.bsb: Now at the end of the twenty years during which Solomon had built the house of the LORD and his own palace,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,
translations.asv: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of Jehovah, and his own house,
